messages:
kiran: Dropping a new mock for the traffic-split slider + rollback confirm microcopy. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/yyy - please scan for a11y and copy clarity.
emily: Nice visual for the split. Concern: current slider handle color is only green vs gray for states. Need an explicit state label for 'paused' and 'active'.
tomas: Slider semantics: can we support fine-grain keyboard adjustments (arrow = 1%, shift+arrow = 5%)? Also suggest snap points at 0, 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100.
aria: Accessibility notes: slider needs aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow and aria-valuetext like 'Traffic: 5 percent to version B'. Add role='slider' and visible focus ring. Announce changes via live region when value stabilizes (debounce 600ms).
lin: Copy: current rollback modal header 'Undo deployment' is vague. Propose 'Rollback to version vX (safe revert)'. Secondary text: 'This will redirect traffic back to prior version. Some requests in flight may still be served.'
kiran: Also proposing 'Simulate' button next to slider that opens a preview panel showing expected latency & error-rate delta using historical metrics for the selected split.
emily: Visual contrast: step labels under slider are 12px gray on light bg, fails AA for 12px. Increase weight or bump to 14px or add stronger color.
tomas: UX tradeoff: if we show predicted errors in preview, we need to avoid implying guaranteed numbers. Microcopy: 'Estimated based on recent traffic' with info icon linking to docs.
aria: For screenreader users, the simulate panel should be keyboard-focusable and announce 'Simulation: 5% traffic to vB. Estimated tail latency +12%.'. Avoid long sentences in live announcements.
lin: Rollback confirmation flow: require checkbox 'I understand this will change live traffic' for high-risk rollbacks (>=50%). Keep lower-risk single click with clear risk badge.
kiran: Prototype includes a compact mobile layout: vertical slider with numeric input fallback. Swipe gestures supported; ensure touch targets >=44px.
deploy-bot: Preview snapshot created: https://app.preview/redwood/traffic-slider/54321 :rocket:
emily: One more: icons for risk (shield, warning) need alt text and textual backup. Do not rely on color alone.
tomas: I'll add keyboard increments and snap points. Planning to file PR for aria attributes + new copy by Thursday.
aria: Will run VoiceOver+TalkBack pass on the snapshot when PR is up. Ping me.
kiran: Thanks all — I'll update Figma with copy and labels and post new link once done. :thumbsup:
